title: Eleven Hands and One Rope
subtitle: 团队与协作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 团队与协作（社会服务与人际沟通·团队合作）
meta: 主题语境：团队与协作（社会服务与人际沟通·团队合作）　|　核心词汇：crew　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 crew 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 my uncle ① joined a crew that had eleven hands and one rope between them, and he said the joining was the whole of the loading. The ② crew, meaning the men and not the boat, worked one tide and stayed that size; crew, he said, is the only thing on a quay that is judged by how few words it needs.

Every ③ crew on that quay had the same caller, and the ④ crew at the end, meaning the one he kept for the winter runs and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever praised twice. Crew, my aunt said, is nine parts caller and one part somebody willing to pull; my uncle said the pulling is the part that fills one tide.

My grandmother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the crew was the whole of the cabin, meaning the people in the seats and not the men with the rope. The ⑥ crew, meaning the people in the seats and not any of that, is the only thing in a cabin that everybody serves and nobody counts; crew, she said, is either something you join or the only word that means both the men with the rope and the people in the seats. He said the people in the seats are the part they remember.

By 1963 the ⑦ crew had become a line in a manifest, and the manifest had become an argument about the caller. The ⑧ crew of the whole thing, my uncle wrote in November, was one rope and thirty years of pulling; crew, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to pull. She said the pulling was never mentioned.

The ⑨ crew I remember is the one at the end, which he joined in 1969 and is still described as the quietest in the county. A ⑩ crew, my aunt said in 1971, is the only thing that improves by being praised; every crew, she said, is a cabin of people that has agreed to look like a set of men. She said the cabin of people was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 全体船员；一组工作人员
B. n. 船员（指那伙人本身，与那条船相对）
C. 固定搭配：join a crew 加入一组船员
D. n. 班组（指那个码头上每一组）
E. n. 班组（指末尾那一组）
F. n. 全体乘务人员；机上／客舱服务人员
G. n. 班组（指舱单上提到的那一组）
H. n. 队；组（抽象总称）

items.q: joined a crew that had eleven hands and one rope
The crew, meaning the men and not the boat
the crew was the whole of the cabin
The crew, meaning the people in the seats
the crew had become a line in a manifest
The crew of the whole thing
A crew, my aunt said in 1971

answers.why: join a crew 意为“加入一组船员”，1955 年叔叔加入了一组共有十一个人、共用一根缆绳的船员。
crew 意为“船员、一组工作人员”，指那伙人本身而不是那条船，他们干了一个潮期。
crew 指那个码头上每一组班组，每一组都有同一个喊号子的人。
crew 指末尾那一组（他留给冬季航次的那组），是唯一有人称赞过两次的。
crew 意为“全体乘务人员”，祖母说乘务组就是那间客舱的全部，指的是机上服务人员而不是拉缆绳的那伙人。
crew 为另一个义项，指机上的乘务人员而不是拉缆绳的那伙人，是客舱里人人都服务、却无人计算的东西。
crew 意为“班组”，指舱单上提到的那一组，到 1963 年这一组成了舱单上的一行。
crew 意为“队、组”，叔叔十一月写道，整件事的队组是一根缆绳三十年的拉拽。
crew 意为“全体船员、一组工作人员”，我记得的是末尾那一组，他 1969 年加入，至今仍被说成全县最安静的。
crew 为抽象总称，姑姑说一组船员是唯一会因为被称赞而变好的东西。
